title: Mascarpone and Yoghurt Sherbet
changes_from_base: Mascarpone and yoghurt with a sugar syrup and lemon replace the orange juice and cream.
summary: Mascarpone and yoghurt beaten with a sugar syrup and lemon make a light, tangy, creamy sherbet to serve with berries.

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: Bring the water and sugar to the boil and simmer for 5 min, then cool and chill.

steps.title: Beat
steps.text: Beat the yoghurt, mascarpone and lemon juice in the bowl until smooth with no lumps.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Whisk in about 320 ml of the cold syrup until evenly mixed.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn for 20-25 min, then freeze for 2 h. Serve with fresh berries.

tips: Use thick whole-milk yoghurt for the creamiest result.
Any leftover syrup keeps in the fridge for drinks or fruit salads.
Serve with lightly sugared strawberries or raspberries.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper on the surface in the freezer for up to 1 week. Soften for 5-10 min before scooping.
